bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Canonical USDai issuance remains native to the PYUSD-backed Arbitrum hub. Ethereum, Base, and Plasma now use OToken v1.1 implementations whose mint/burn functions require the constructor-fixed LayerZero OAdapter; stored BRIDGE_ADMIN_ROLE grants remain but no longer authorize token minting in the current logic. The adapter is still owned by a chain-local Safe, 3-of-3 on Ethereum and Base and 3-of-4 on Plasma. Proxy upgrades remain governed by chain-local 48-hour DVNTimelocks. Historical role-grant mint exposure is retained in the route notes, and all satellite transfer controls remain Bridge Risk.
